name: Space Love!
source:
A sci-fi comedy parody of what most people think of when they think of visual novels.

Features:
* Multiple endings!
* Real-time emotions!
* Not really!
* SPACE!!!!
* Possibility of robot love!

[Edited from [url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]official site[/url]]
